issues.where: the water trickle on the left of the base, crops 1 and 5
issues.what: the trickle is a smooth resin ribbon with beaded highlights, and it does not wet or darken the stone beside it
issues.fix: break it into a thin wet film, darken the stone along it, and drop the painted highlight beads

issues.where: the thick roots across the front of the base, crop 6
issues.what: the roots are flat ribbons of straight segments and sharp corners, not round wood
issues.fix: round the root sections so the silhouette is a curve, and vary the bark so it is not a stretched strip

issues.where: the line where the roots meet the reflective surface, crop 11
issues.what: the roots end on a hard cut into the mirror plane, with no wet line and no contact shadow
issues.fix: add a thin dark wet line and a soft shadow along the contact, and let the reflection soften off that line

issues.where: the cottage and the tree inside the glass, out to the left and right edges
issues.what: the inside is not bent or enlarged by the liquid; it stays straight and the same scale up to the glass
issues.fix: enlarge the interior and bend it toward the rim, strongest at the left and right edges

issues.where: the petals lying on the surface, crops 11 and 12
issues.what: the petals are paper-flat and dry, with no thickness and no wet edge where they meet the surface
issues.fix: give each petal a little thickness and a thin wet contact where it lies

issues.where: the mushrooms on the moss, crops 2 and 4
issues.what: the caps repeat the same smooth shape, like small toys rather than grown mushrooms
issues.fix: vary the caps and stems, and tuck the stems into the moss with a small shadow
